recipes.title: Code directory to a reviewable context pack
recipes.title_zh: 把代码目录整理成可审查的上下文文件
recipes.summary: Collect supported source files into Markdown with relative paths, file limits, and an inclusion manifest.
recipes.input: One local code directory; Git is recommended for ignore rules
recipes.output: A Markdown file and a sibling .manifest.json file

recipes.title: Saved HTML to readable Markdown
recipes.title_zh: 把已保存的 HTML 转成 Markdown
recipes.summary: Convert a local HTML file into a reading document with headings, links, tables, and code.
recipes.input: One UTF-8 HTML file, up to 5 MB

recipes.title: Markdown to traceable JSONL chunks
recipes.title_zh: 把长文切分成保留来源与位置的 JSONL 片段
recipes.summary: Split a local Markdown document by character budget, preserving every decoded character and source offsets.
recipes.input: One UTF-8 Markdown file, up to 10 MB
recipes.output: JSONL records with source, character offsets, stable IDs, and text
